Paccal Vet
Cancer treatment specifically designed for pets
Paccal Vet is an investigational drug currently being evaluated in two veterinary studies – learn more below
A clinical study for dogs with splenic hemangiosarcoma after splenectomy
Fully funded study, no cost to pet owner
No placebo, all dogs receive active treatment
Paccal Vet is based on a cancer drug widely used in human medicine
RECRUITMENT COMPLETED
A dose-finding study for cats with solid tumors
Fully funded study, no cost to pet owner
No placebo, all cats receive active treatment
Paccal Vet is based on a cancer drug widely used in human medicine
